dialogues.jp:
図書室で、勉強する気も本を読む気もないが、
昼寝をする気だけはバッチリある。
dialogues.en:
The library, more than a place to study or to read, is a
place to sleep!
dialogues.text:
The library, more than a place to study or to read, is a
place to sleep!

dialogues.jp:
いごこちのよさそうな席を見つけ、そこを目指
す。
dialogues.en: I started to search for a comfortable-looking desk.
dialogues.text: I started to search for a comfortable-looking desk.

dialogues.speaker: Sugiami
dialogues.jp: 「よ、わが同志よ」
dialogues.en: "Greetings, my comrade."
dialogues.text: "Greetings, my comrade."

dialogues.jp:
会いたくない人間に会ってしまった。なんで、
こいつがここにいるんだ。
dialogues.en: Not someone I wanted to meet now. What's he doing here?
dialogues.text: Not someone I wanted to meet now. What's he doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どこ行くんだ？　妖気でも感じたか？」
dialogues.en: "Where are you going? Did you see a ghost?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you going? Did you see a ghost?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。妖怪、居眠り小僧が俺を誘ってるんで
　な……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, that little ghost named Morpheus is inviting me to
another world..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, that little ghost named Morpheus is inviting me to
another world..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「せいぜい、妖怪退治に励んでくれ」
dialogues.en: "Give the word, and I'd commence extermination."
dialogues.text: "Give the word, and I'd commence extermination."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「任せてくれ。ちょうどいい席を見つけてるん
　でな」
dialogues.en: "As you wish. Meanwhile, I'd continue to find a nice desk."
dialogues.text: "As you wish. Meanwhile, I'd continue to find a nice desk."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、待て。俺も何も冗談でお前を引き留め
　たわけじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Well, wait a second. I didn't stop you just to fool around
with you."
dialogues.text:
"Well, wait a second. I didn't stop you just to fool around
with you."

dialogues.jp: 本気で引き留められても嫌なんだが。
dialogues.en:
Doesn't make a difference on whether I want to be stopped or
not.
dialogues.text:
Doesn't make a difference on whether I want to be stopped or
not.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「例の転校生のことで、ちょっと面白い噂を聞
　いたんだが……」
dialogues.en:
"I've happened upon an interesting rumour regarding a
certain transfer student..."
dialogues.text:
"I've happened upon an interesting rumour regarding a
certain transfer student..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「聞きたいか？」
dialogues.en: "Want to hear it?"
dialogues.text: "Want to hear it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「例の転校生って？」
dialogues.en: "A certain transfer student?"
dialogues.text: "A certain transfer student?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前の｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝だ」
dialogues.en: "Your fiancee, of course."
dialogues.text: "Your fiancee, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
（く……っ。こいつだけは、しぶとく覚えてい
　たか）
dialogues.en: "(Grah... this guy has the memory of an elephant.)"
dialogues.text: "(Grah... this guy has the memory of an elephant.)"

dialogues.jp:
役に立たない知識ばかり、脳にたらふくため込
みやがって……。
dialogues.en: He can eremember even this useless stuff...
dialogues.text: He can eremember even this useless stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「で、聞きたいのか？　聞きたくないのか？」
dialogues.en: "So, do you want to listen, or not?"
dialogues.text: "So, do you want to listen, or not?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……お前が話したいのなら聞いてやる」
dialogues.en: "...If you want to talk, I'd listen."
dialogues.text: "...If you want to talk, I'd listen."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢は、時々、突拍子もない行動に出る
　のは知ってるよな」
dialogues.en:
"You are of course, aware that Konomiya occasionally
performs acts of what some would call craziness."
dialogues.text:
"You are of course, aware that Konomiya occasionally
performs acts of what some would call craziness."

dialogues.jp: ……話したかったのか。
dialogues.en: ...And so it begins.
dialogues.text: ...And so it begins.

dialogues.jp:
ツッコミを入れようと思ったが、面倒くさいの
でやめた。
dialogues.en:
I thought of playing stupid, but figured it'd be too much
trouble.
dialogues.text:
I thought of playing stupid, but figured it'd be too much
trouble.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、なあ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, yes."
dialogues.text: "Well, yes."

dialogues.jp: 目の前で丼が真っ二つになるのを見れば……。
dialogues.en: Having seen that bowl split into two by her...
dialogues.text: Having seen that bowl split into two by her...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それがすごい噂になってるのさ」
dialogues.en: "Strange rumours has come about from that incident."
dialogues.text: "Strange rumours has come about from that incident."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ある者はいきなり廊下で殴られ、路地で体当
　たりをくらい……」
dialogues.en:
"One person was walking down a road, when he was suddenly
knocked to the side, into an alleyway..."
dialogues.text:
"One person was walking down a road, when he was suddenly
knocked to the side, into an alleyway..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「またある者は、不意に自分の真横を矢が｛かす／掠｝め
　たりしているらしい」
dialogues.en:
"And another person had an arrow shot at him, barely grazing
him."
dialogues.text:
"And another person had an arrow shot at him, barely grazing
him."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……確かな情報で言ってるんだろうな」
dialogues.en: "...Would that be your so-called intelligence?"
dialogues.text: "...Would that be your so-called intelligence?"

dialogues.jp: 俺もその噂は耳にしたことがある。
dialogues.en: Even I've heard about that.
dialogues.text: Even I've heard about that.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、俺の反論しようとする姿勢に、なぜか
嬉しそうな笑みを浮かべて、話を続けた。
dialogues.en:
But Suginami continued his story, with that wry smile on his
lips.
dialogues.text:
But Suginami continued his story, with that wry smile on his
lips.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「特定のターゲットがいるわけでもないらしい。
　男女も問わずだからな」
dialogues.en:
"It appears there wasn't a specific target in mind, over the
several incidents. Targets were indiscriminate."
dialogues.text:
"It appears there wasn't a specific target in mind, over the
several incidents. Targets were indiscriminate."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それから、だ。ここがけっこう重要だと思う
　んだが……」
dialogues.en: "So, that leaves just one important common factor..."
dialogues.text: "So, that leaves just one important common factor..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんなとき胡ノ宮嬢は決まって巫女装束にな
　るらしい」
dialogues.en:
"On every one of those incidents, Konomiya would always be
wearing her Miko dress."
dialogues.text:
"On every one of those incidents, Konomiya would always be
wearing her Miko dress."

dialogues.jp: どこが重要なんだ？
dialogues.en: That's important now?
dialogues.text: That's important now?

dialogues.jp: ……って、ツッコミ所はそこじゃない。
dialogues.en: ...But, no place to play stupid now.
dialogues.text: ...But, no place to play stupid now.

dialogues.jp:
「おい、環はいつもあの服を制服の下に着てる
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "Oy, doesn't Tamaki always wear that underneath her uniform?
dialogues.text: "Oy, doesn't Tamaki always wear that underneath her uniform?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことだ」
dialogues.en: "Indeed."
dialogues.text: "Indeed."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が重々しくうなずいた。
dialogues.en: Suginami nodded repeatedly.
dialogues.text: Suginami nodded repeatedly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢が制服を脱いだとき、災いが起こる
　とまで言われているらしいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"In other words, the moment Konomiya removes her school
uniform, is one where disaster is guaranteed to strike."
dialogues.text:
"In other words, the moment Konomiya removes her school
uniform, is one where disaster is guaranteed to strike."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、どことなく近寄り難いところもあるし、
　行動も謎が多い」
dialogues.en:
"Additionally, the subject appears to be one she cannot
speak about, yet her behaviour continues to be a puzzle."
dialogues.text:
"Additionally, the subject appears to be one she cannot
speak about, yet her behaviour continues to be a puzzle."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そんなところが噂に拍車をかけているな」
dialogues.en: "That has only encouraged the gossip further."
dialogues.text: "That has only encouraged the gossip further."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「不幸を呼ぶ巫女……ってことか」
dialogues.en: "So, you mean... a Miko which brings forth misfortune?"
dialogues.text: "So, you mean... a Miko which brings forth misfortune?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「甘いな、朝倉。だから凡人は困る」
dialogues.en: "How naive, Asakura. I worry about you sometimes."
dialogues.text: "How naive, Asakura. I worry about you sometimes."

dialogues.jp:
両手を広げて、やれやれとあからさまに“困っ
た”リアクションをとる。
dialogues.en:
He spread his arms out, shaking his head in mock
disappointment.
dialogues.text:
He spread his arms out, shaking his head in mock
disappointment.

dialogues.jp:
変人扱いはされたくないが、杉並に凡人扱いさ
れるのも、何となくむかつく。
dialogues.en: I'd be worried if you were someone worried about me...
dialogues.text: I'd be worried if you were someone worried about me...

dialogues.jp: 「何だよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "Then what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Then what do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並は真面目な表情を取り戻した。
dialogues.en: He reverted back to his serious face.
dialogues.text: He reverted back to his serious face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「表面を見ればそうなのだが、意外と奥が深い」
dialogues.en:
"Although that's what it appears like on the surface, the
real reason lies far deeper within."
dialogues.text:
"Although that's what it appears like on the surface, the
real reason lies far deeper within."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「“巫女さん萌え”な昨今、『なんちゃって巫
　女』が多い中、彼女は本物に違いない」
dialogues.en:
"With the "Miko-san, moeeee~" fad going around, amongst the
several impostors, that girl is the real deal."
dialogues.text:
"With the "Miko-san, moeeee~" fad going around, amongst the
several impostors, that girl is the real deal."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本物？」
dialogues.en: "The real deal?"
dialogues.text: "The real deal?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「これはあくまでも俺の憶測なんだが……。彼
　女には不思議な力が宿っている気がするんだ」
dialogues.en:
"This would just be my conjecture... but I believe that girl
is hiding a strange power that she possesses."
dialogues.text:
"This would just be my conjecture... but I believe that girl
is hiding a strange power that she possesses."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "...Meaning?"
dialogues.text: "...Meaning?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「彼女は未来が見えるんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "That she can see the future?"
dialogues.text: "That she can see the future?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前の妄想には、時々驚かされるよ」
dialogues.en:
"You had me going for a second, I thought it'd actually be
plausible."
dialogues.text:
"You had me going for a second, I thought it'd actually be
plausible."

dialogues.jp: まぁ、超常現象好きな奴だしな。
dialogues.en:
Well, I should've expected this from this phenomena-loving
guy.
dialogues.text:
Well, I should've expected this from this phenomena-loving
guy.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あながち、そうでもないと思うぞ」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so quick to dismiss it."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so quick to dismiss it."

dialogues.jp:
よほど自信があるのか、笑みさえ浮かべながら
杉並は力説する。
dialogues.en: Still filled with confidence, he started speaking again.
dialogues.text: Still filled with confidence, he started speaking again.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢にやられた連中は、その直後に交差
　点で事故がおきたり、工事現場で、鉄筋が落
　ちてきたりしているらしい」
dialogues.en:
"The person that Konomiya had knocked down, would've been
hit by a stray steel ball from nearby construction works
otherwise.゛
dialogues.text:
"The person that Konomiya had knocked down, would've been
hit by a stray steel ball from nearby construction works
otherwise.゛

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「先日、転校初日に食堂で起こした──その名
　も『ドンブリ串刺し事件』も……」
dialogues.en:
"And that day, during the first day of the transfer student,
during the "Skewered Plate Incident"..."
dialogues.text:
"And that day, during the first day of the transfer student,
during the "Skewered Plate Incident"..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そば粉アレルギーの学生が、彼女の矢のおか
　げで助かっている」
dialogues.en:
"The so-called victim, having a soba flour allergy, was in
actual fact saved by her arrow."
dialogues.text:
"The so-called victim, having a soba flour allergy, was in
actual fact saved by her arrow."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「と、言うと？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, you mean...?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, you mean...?"

dialogues.jp: 俺もあの事件の目撃者だけに、興味がある。
dialogues.en: Being an eyewitness of that scene, my interest was piqued.
dialogues.text: Being an eyewitness of that scene, my interest was piqued.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「男子学生が食べてたのはだな、スペシャルメ
　ニューの『隠し味はそば粉のカツどん』だっ
　たのだ」
dialogues.en:
"The male student had unwittingly ordered a special menu
"Delicious Soba Flour Katsudon"."
dialogues.text:
"The male student had unwittingly ordered a special menu
"Delicious Soba Flour Katsudon"."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そば粉のカツどん？」
dialogues.en: "Soba flour katsudon?"
dialogues.text: "Soba flour katsudon?"

dialogues.jp: さすが食堂メニュー。侮れん……。
dialogues.en: The cafeteria menu is really something to be feared...
dialogues.text: The cafeteria menu is really something to be feared...

dialogues.jp: どこに何が入っているかわからんな……。
dialogues.en: Who knows what else they put in their food...
dialogues.text: Who knows what else they put in their food...

dialogues.jp: じゃなくって。
dialogues.en: But anyway...
dialogues.text: But anyway...

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ……」
dialogues.en: "Then, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Then, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。そう言うことだ。彼女が災害を知って
　いて回避したといっても、過言ではない」
dialogues.en:
It would not be an exaggeration to say that she knew of the
disasters, and tried her best to keep them from happening."
dialogues.text:
It would not be an exaggeration to say that she knew of the
disasters, and tried her best to keep them from happening."

dialogues.jp:
確かに、そう仮定すると、すっきり解決するの
だが。
dialogues.en: That theory really would clear up a lot of questions...
dialogues.text: That theory really would clear up a lot of questions...

dialogues.jp: 「そうなのかねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Is that really it...?"
dialogues.text: "Is that really it...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、真実はそのうち、自ずと姿を見せるだ
　ろう。そういうものだ」
dialogues.en:
"Find out the truth for yourself, if you wish. That was all
I had to say."
dialogues.text:
"Find out the truth for yourself, if you wish. That was all
I had to say."

dialogues.jp: キザな決め台詞を残して、杉並は去っていった。
dialogues.en: Leaving his conceited words behind, he left the library.
dialogues.text: Leaving his conceited words behind, he left the library.

dialogues.jp: 本当に話したいだけ話していったな、あいつ。
dialogues.en: When I actually want to talk, he leaves, of course...
dialogues.text: When I actually want to talk, he leaves, of course...

dialogues.jp:
俺の座ろうとしていた席のすぐ側には、環が座っ
て勉強していた。
dialogues.en: I then realized that Tamaki was sitting nearby, studying.
dialogues.text: I then realized that Tamaki was sitting nearby, studying.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp:
席の近くに立っている俺に気づき、にっこりと
会釈をする。
dialogues.en:
Noticing me standing at a nearby table, she bowed in
greeting to me, smiling.
dialogues.text:
Noticing me standing at a nearby table, she bowed in
greeting to me, smiling.

dialogues.jp: （杉並があんなこと言うから……）
dialogues.en: "(Those things he said...)"
dialogues.text: "(Those things he said...)"

dialogues.jp: 何となく、意識してしまう。
dialogues.en: I couldn't get them out of my mind.
dialogues.text: I couldn't get them out of my mind.

dialogues.jp: 「よう。進んでるか？」
dialogues.en: "Yo, studying hard?"
dialogues.text: "Yo, studying hard?"

dialogues.jp: 努めて普通に振舞う。
dialogues.en: I tried my best to act normal.
dialogues.text: I tried my best to act normal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。今日は生物を勉強してるんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I'm studying biology today."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I'm studying biology today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そう。じゃ、俺も……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see. I guess I will too..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see. I guess I will too..."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに俺も環の前じゃ、寝る気になれない。
適当な本を引っ張り出して、席に座る。
dialogues.en:
In front of her, I certainly didn't have any mood to sleep.
I grabbed a suitable book and sat next to her.
dialogues.text:
In front of her, I certainly didn't have any mood to sleep.
I grabbed a suitable book and sat next to her.

dialogues.jp: 何となく気になって環を見ると。
dialogues.en: Feeling something was wrong, I glanced at Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Feeling something was wrong, I glanced at Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 珍しいことに、環がそわそわしていた。
dialogues.en: Oddly for her, she was fidgeting around nervously.
dialogues.text: Oddly for her, she was fidgeting around nervously.

dialogues.jp:
消しゴムを何度もかけたり、シャープペンをカ
チカチとノックしたり。
dialogues.en:
She kept twirling her eraser around,and lightly knocked her
pencil into the table.
dialogues.text:
She kept twirling her eraser around,and lightly knocked her
pencil into the table.

dialogues.jp: いつもと明らかに様子が違う。
dialogues.en: Far from her usual behaviour.
dialogues.text: Far from her usual behaviour.

dialogues.jp:
そんな風にされると、俺まで集中できなくなる
じゃないか。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't concentrate on my book with that beside me,
either.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't concentrate on my book with that beside me,
either.

dialogues.jp:
俺が環を見ていると、環が俺を上目遣いで見つ
めてきた。
dialogues.en:
I turned to look at her again, and this time, she turned to
face me as well.
dialogues.text:
I turned to look at her again, and this time, she turned to
face me as well.

dialogues.jp: （な、なんだ？）
dialogues.en: "(W, what?)"
dialogues.text: "(W, what?)"

dialogues.jp: まさか、環を盗み見ていたのがばれたのか？
dialogues.en: Did she catch me trying to steal glances at her?
dialogues.text: Did she catch me trying to steal glances at her?

dialogues.jp: バクバクする心臓を必死に押さえていると……。
dialogues.en: I did all I could to calm my rapidly-beating heart...
dialogues.text: I did all I could to calm my rapidly-beating heart...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環がいきなり顔を近づけてきた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki suddenly brought her face closer to mine.
dialogues.text: Tamaki suddenly brought her face closer to mine.

dialogues.jp: 吐息が感じられるくらいの位置まで。
dialogues.en: Close enough to feel her breath on my face.
dialogues.text: Close enough to feel her breath on my face.

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず後ずさりをする。
dialogues.en: I reactively leaned backwards slightly.
dialogues.text: I reactively leaned backwards slightly.

dialogues.jp: （だだだ、だって、ここは図書室なんだし…）
dialogues.en: "(T, t, t, this is a library...)"
dialogues.text: "(T, t, t, this is a library...)"

dialogues.jp: いきなりって言うのは……その、色々困る。
dialogues.en:
If I had said that out loud... perhaps I'd have regretted
it.
dialogues.text:
If I had said that out loud... perhaps I'd have regretted
it.

dialogues.jp:
だが、そんな俺にお構いなしに、環は真剣な表
情で俺に訴える。
dialogues.en:
But, seemingly unaware of my own odd behaviour, she
earnestly asked of me.
dialogues.text:
But, seemingly unaware of my own odd behaviour, she
earnestly asked of me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの、これからお願いすることを、何も聞か
　ないで実行して欲しいんです……」
dialogues.en:
"Um, please don't say anything about what I am going to ask
of you..."
dialogues.text:
"Um, please don't say anything about what I am going to ask
of you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （目を閉じてくれとか言うのかな……？）
dialogues.en: "(Is she going to tell me to close my eyes...?)"
dialogues.text: "(Is she going to tell me to close my eyes...?)"

dialogues.jp: 言われる前に、俺が目を閉じようとしていると。
dialogues.en:
Before I even thought that, my eyes instinctively closed by
themselves.
dialogues.text:
Before I even thought that, my eyes instinctively closed by
themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あそこの窓に居る人たち」
dialogues.en: "Those people at the window..."
dialogues.text: "Those people at the window..."

dialogues.jp:
間の抜けた声を出しながら、環が指す方向を見
る。
dialogues.en:
Bringing myself back to reality, I looked at where Tamaki
was pointing.
dialogues.text:
Bringing myself back to reality, I looked at where Tamaki
was pointing.

dialogues.jp: そこには窓があって、横に本棚があって。
dialogues.en: There was a window in between bookshelves.
dialogues.text: There was a window in between bookshelves.

dialogues.jp: その前の机で、６人の学生が勉強していた。
dialogues.en:
Six students were studying at the desk in front of the
window.
dialogues.text:
Six students were studying at the desk in front of the
window.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの人たちを、図書室の外に出して欲しいん
　です」
dialogues.en: "Those people... need to move from the library."
dialogues.text: "Those people... need to move from the library."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「また、どうして……」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you..."
dialogues.text: "W, what are you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お願いです。何も聞かないで下さい」
dialogues.en: "Please, don't say anything about it!"
dialogues.text: "Please, don't say anything about it!"

dialogues.jp: 環は必死に俺に訴える。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was pleading to me desperately.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was pleading to me desperately.

dialogues.jp: 俺が想像していたのとは違ったけど……。
dialogues.en: It wasn't quite what I had imagined, but...
dialogues.text: It wasn't quite what I had imagined, but...

dialogues.jp: 環の瞳は切羽詰るものがあって。
dialogues.en: I couldn't win against those eyes of hers.
dialogues.text: I couldn't win against those eyes of hers.

dialogues.jp: 「わかった」
dialogues.en: "I got it."
dialogues.text: "I got it."

dialogues.jp: 俺はうなずいた。
dialogues.en: I nodded, accepting her plea.
dialogues.text: I nodded, accepting her plea.

dialogues.jp:
問題の机へと足を運びながら、何と言って追い
出すか考える。
dialogues.en:
I began to walk to that desk, wondering how I could chase
them out nicely...
dialogues.text:
I began to walk to that desk, wondering how I could chase
them out nicely...

dialogues.jp:
『隕石が落ちてきた』じゃ、リアリティのかけ
らもないし。
dialogues.en:
Saying somethig like "a meteorite is going to fall here"
probably won't sit too well with them.
dialogues.text:
Saying somethig like "a meteorite is going to fall here"
probably won't sit too well with them.

dialogues.jp:
それどころか、俺は学園の狼少年として名を馳
せるようになるだろう。
dialogues.en:
And besides, I also have a reputation of being quite the
prankster around school...
dialogues.text:
And besides, I also have a reputation of being quite the
prankster around school...

dialogues.jp: うーむ。
dialogues.en: Hmm.
dialogues.text: Hmm.

dialogues.jp: 答えが出ないまま、問題の机へとたどり着く。
dialogues.en: Before I could come up with an answer, I'd reached the desk.
dialogues.text: Before I could come up with an answer, I'd reached the desk.

dialogues.en: "Excuse me..."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me..."

dialogues.jp: ６人が一斉に俺を見る。
dialogues.en: All six of them looked at me simultaneously.
dialogues.text: All six of them looked at me simultaneously.

dialogues.jp:
「悪いんだけど、この場所、風紀委員の会議で
　今から使うんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry, but the discplinary committee is set to have a
meeting at this location soon."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry, but the discplinary committee is set to have a
meeting at this location soon."

dialogues.jp: 「どいてくれないかな？」
dialogues.en: "Could you move to a different spot?"
dialogues.text: "Could you move to a different spot?"

dialogues.jp: ま、妥当な線だろう。
dialogues.en: That sounds pretty good.
dialogues.text: That sounds pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「え〜？　何でここなんですか？　他にも場所
　あるじゃないっすか」
dialogues.en: "Ehh~? Here? Can't they have it somewhere else?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh~? Here? Can't they have it somewhere else?"

dialogues.jp: ……我ながら、出だしを失敗したな。
dialogues.en: ...Or maybe not.
dialogues.text: ...Or maybe not.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺もそう思うんだがな。風紀委員がそ
　ういってるんだから、仕方ないだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"I know, I don't know why they can't, either. But it's the
discplinary committee, nothing can be done about it, right?"
dialogues.text:
"I know, I don't know why they can't, either. But it's the
discplinary committee, nothing can be done about it, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「いくら、先輩の頼みでも、突然そりゃないっ
　すよ……」
dialogues.en:
"The upperclassmen always have such unfair priority over
us..."
dialogues.text:
"The upperclassmen always have such unfair priority over
us..."

dialogues.jp: くそ、聞き分けの悪いやつだ。
dialogues.en: Damnit, these guys aren't docile like I hoped.
dialogues.text: Damnit, these guys aren't docile like I hoped.

dialogues.jp:
ま、確かに理不尽なのは分からないでもないん
だけど……俺にも環に任された責任っつーもん
があるんだよ。
dialogues.en:
I know it's unreasonable myself, but... Tamaki requested me
to do this.
dialogues.text:
I know it's unreasonable myself, but... Tamaki requested me
to do this.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったる」
dialogues.en: "...So troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...So troublesome."

dialogues.jp: 呟いて。
dialogues.en: I took a deep breath.
dialogues.text: I took a deep breath.

dialogues.jp:
「……悪いことは言わない。早く退いた方がい
　い」
dialogues.en:
"...I'd say this much. It'd be best for everyone if you
leave here now."
dialogues.text:
"...I'd say this much. It'd be best for everyone if you
leave here now."

dialogues.jp: 「……卒業パーティー、無事に迎えたいだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"...You want the graduation party to go smoothly, don't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"...You want the graduation party to go smoothly, don't
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 無茶苦茶な展開だな……。
dialogues.en: Confusion reigned among them.
dialogues.text: Confusion reigned among them.

dialogues.jp:
「風紀委員なんて、何をするかわからない連中
　だぜ？　ここはおとなしくしておいた方が身
　のためだと思う」
dialogues.en:
"The disciplinary committee knows all sorts of interesting
people. It would be best if you just leave quietly."
dialogues.text:
"The disciplinary committee knows all sorts of interesting
people. It would be best if you just leave quietly."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、脅しすぎだとは思うが……。
dialogues.en: That's probably enough threatening...
dialogues.text: That's probably enough threatening...

dialogues.jp:
「かったるいかもしれんが、俺だって風紀委員
　に｛にら／睨｝まれたくないんだ。頼む」
dialogues.en:
"I know it's troublesome, but I don't want to be targeted by
them either. Please."
dialogues.text:
"I know it's troublesome, but I don't want to be targeted by
them either. Please."

dialogues.jp: おおげさに、パン！　と手を合わせて頼む。
dialogues.en: I exaggeratedly clapsed my hands together.
dialogues.text: I exaggeratedly clapsed my hands together.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「なあ、この人、さっきかったるいとか言って
　なかったか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, didn't he just say "troublesome" just now?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, didn't he just say "troublesome" just now?"

dialogues.jp: 連中が、ボソボソと話を始める。
dialogues.en: They then started to talk among themselves.
dialogues.text: They then started to talk among themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「……というと？　ま、まさか……あ……、朝
　倉、先輩？」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, so? ....Y, you don't mean... A... Asakura-senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, so? ....Y, you don't mean... A... Asakura-senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、風見学園一の危険人物、杉並先輩と双
　璧をなすと言われているあの人だ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, one pair of the dangerous duo with Suginami-senpai!"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, one pair of the dangerous duo with Suginami-senpai!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「……まずいよ。朝倉先輩って言ったら、杉並
　先輩と同じくらいヤバイ人なんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"...This is bad. Asakura-senpai has to be as bad as
Suginami-senpai, right?"
dialogues.text:
"...This is bad. Asakura-senpai has to be as bad as
Suginami-senpai, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「……お、俺、死にたくないよ！　なあ、いい
　じゃねえか、先輩の言うとおりにしようぜ？」
dialogues.en: "...I, I don't want to die! Let's just do what he says!"
dialogues.text: "...I, I don't want to die! Let's just do what he says!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、朝倉先輩を敵に回したら、俺ら学校来
　れないよ……！」
dialogues.en:
"If we make enemies of Asakura-senpai, we won't be able to
come go to this school anymore...!"
dialogues.text:
"If we make enemies of Asakura-senpai, we won't be able to
come go to this school anymore...!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「それに、その朝倉先輩が、これだけ恐れてい
　る風紀委員って……」
dialogues.en:
"And, if this Asakura-senpai is so terrified of the
disciplinary committee..."
dialogues.text:
"And, if this Asakura-senpai is so terrified of the
disciplinary committee..."

dialogues.jp:
……俺は、どういうイメージで後輩から見られ
てるんだ？
dialogues.en:
...What the hell kind of image do I have among the
lowerclassmen, now?
dialogues.text:
...What the hell kind of image do I have among the
lowerclassmen, now?

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「ハハハ、先輩。どうぞ。ご自由に使ってくだ
　さい……」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, senpai, please, use the place as you wish..."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, senpai, please, use the place as you wish..."

dialogues.jp:
連中は何やら妙な汗をかきながら、極端な愛想
笑いを浮かべながら、席を離れていった。
dialogues.en:
Sweatdrops ran down their faces, with extremely polite
smiles, as they left the desk.
dialogues.text:
Sweatdrops ran down their faces, with extremely polite
smiles, as they left the desk.

dialogues.jp:
微妙に納得のいかない結果だったが……まあ、
任務成功には変わりない。
dialogues.en:
The means may not have been the best... but at least the
objective was fulfilled.
dialogues.text:
The means may not have been the best... but at least the
objective was fulfilled.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 振り返ると、環が必死で手招きしていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to see Tamaki desperately waving to me,
trying to get my attention.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to see Tamaki desperately waving to me,
trying to get my attention.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「早く！　こちらに来てください！」
dialogues.en: "Hurry! Come over here!"
dialogues.text: "Hurry! Come over here!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだよ、そんなにせっぱ詰まった顔
　して。何かあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's with that worrisome face?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that worrisome face?"

dialogues.jp: 俺がのんびりと言ったとき──。
dialogues.en: I talked to her casually, when...
dialogues.text: I talked to her casually, when...

dialogues.jp: ガタッ！
dialogues.en: *bam!*
dialogues.text: *bam!*

dialogues.jp: 何か音がした。
dialogues.en: A sound rang through the library.
dialogues.text: A sound rang through the library.

dialogues.jp:
音の正体を確かめようと、後ろを振り返ると、
本棚が大きく揺れていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned towards the direction of the sound behind me, to
see the bookshelves swaying.
dialogues.text:
I turned towards the direction of the sound behind me, to
see the bookshelves swaying.

dialogues.jp:
すごく嫌な予感、ものすごく、ヤバイ、マジヤ
バイ。
dialogues.en: I have a bad feeling about this. A really bad feeling.
dialogues.text: I have a bad feeling about this. A really bad feeling.

dialogues.jp: 俺が全速力で環のいる方へと走り出した瞬間。
dialogues.en:
With all the power in my legs, I dashed to where Tamaki was
standing.
dialogues.text:
With all the power in my legs, I dashed to where Tamaki was
standing.

dialogues.jp:
それと同時に、本棚が机に向かって──つまり、
俺に向かって倒れてくる。
dialogues.en:
At the same time, the bookshelves started falling in the
direction of the desk; the direction of where I was.
dialogues.text:
At the same time, the bookshelves started falling in the
direction of the desk; the direction of where I was.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様ーーーー！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama~~~!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama~~~!"

dialogues.jp:
環が俺の手を取り、自分の方に力いっぱい引き
寄せる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki grabbed onto my outstretched hand, and pulled me
further towards her.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki grabbed onto my outstretched hand, and pulled me
further towards her.

dialogues.jp: ガッターン！！！
dialogues.en: *crash!!*
dialogues.text: *crash!!*

dialogues.jp:
本棚は前のめりになって机にあたり、周りにバ
サバサと本が飛び散った。
dialogues.en:
With a loud crash, the bookshelf fell on top of the desk,
scattering books everywhere.
dialogues.text:
With a loud crash, the bookshelf fell on top of the desk,
scattering books everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うっひゃぁ〜……」
dialogues.en: "Oh maaan~..."
dialogues.text: "Oh maaan~..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の意識はあっち側の世界に行ったままだった
が。
dialogues.en: My senses were in another world, after that escape.
dialogues.text: My senses were in another world, after that escape.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よ、よかった」
dialogues.en: "Oh my..."
dialogues.text: "Oh my..."

dialogues.jp: 環の呟きで、戻って来られた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's muttering brought me back to the real world.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's muttering brought me back to the real world.

dialogues.jp: 「し、死ぬかと思った……」
dialogues.en: "I, I thought I was going to die..."
dialogues.text: "I, I thought I was going to die..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかったです……ほんとによかった……」
dialogues.en: "I'm relieved... I'm so relieved..."
dialogues.text: "I'm relieved... I'm so relieved..."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の腕を握り締めたまま何度も呟いて。
dialogues.en:
She held on tightly to my arm, whispering to herself
continuously.
dialogues.text:
She held on tightly to my arm, whispering to herself
continuously.

dialogues.jp: なぜかボロボロと涙をこぼした。
dialogues.en: Her teardrops began to stain my sleeve.
dialogues.text: Her teardrops began to stain my sleeve.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何で泣いてるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "W, why are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "W, why are you crying?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……だ、だって……朝倉様にもしものことが
　あったら……」
dialogues.en: "...B, because... if that happened to you...."
dialogues.text: "...B, because... if that happened to you...."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「もしものことって……」
dialogues.en: "If that had happened..."
dialogues.text: "If that had happened..."

dialogues.jp: 本棚を見る。
dialogues.en: I looked back at the bookshelves.
dialogues.text: I looked back at the bookshelves.

dialogues.jp: あの下敷きってことか……。
dialogues.en: If I was under that mess...
dialogues.text: If I was under that mess...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった……本当によかったです……」
dialogues.en: "I'm so... relieved... and glad..."
dialogues.text: "I'm so... relieved... and glad..."

dialogues.jp: 環の涙はとまらなかった。
dialogues.en: Her tears wouldn't stop flowing.
dialogues.text: Her tears wouldn't stop flowing.

dialogues.jp: （俺のこと、そこまで心配してくれたんだな）
dialogues.en: "(She was really worried about me...)"
dialogues.text: "(She was really worried about me...)"

dialogues.jp:
そう思うと、何だか心がホッとあたたかくなる
ような気がした。
dialogues.en:
I felt warm inside, knowing there was someone who cared
about me so much.
dialogues.text:
I felt warm inside, knowing there was someone who cared
about me so much.

dialogues.jp: 「ありがとな。もう、大丈夫だから」
dialogues.en: "Thanks. I'm alright, everything's fine."
dialogues.text: "Thanks. I'm alright, everything's fine."

dialogues.jp: 環の肩にそっと手を置く。
dialogues.en: I patted her on the shoulder.
dialogues.text: I patted her on the shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
環は何度も頷いて見せたが、涙は止まる気配が
なく、いつまでも泣き続けた。
dialogues.en:
She ndoded a few times, but her tears still wouldn't stop,
and her crying continued.
dialogues.text:
She ndoded a few times, but her tears still wouldn't stop,
and her crying continued.

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく」

まるで俺が泣かせてるみたいだと思ったが……
環が落ち着くまでこうしていようと思った。
dialogues.en: Maybe it'd take me starting to cry before she calms down.
dialogues.text: Maybe it'd take me starting to cry before she calms down.

dialogues.jp: （杉並の言ってたこと、本当なのかもしれん）
dialogues.en: "(And maybe that Suginami was correct...)"
dialogues.text: "(And maybe that Suginami was correct...)"

dialogues.jp: 環は、本棚が倒れてくるのを分かってたんだ。
dialogues.en: She did know that the bookcase was going to collapse.
dialogues.text: She did know that the bookcase was going to collapse.

dialogues.jp: だから、俺に６人をどけるように言ったんだ。
dialogues.en:
That must've been why she had me chase off those six
students...
dialogues.text:
That must've been why she had me chase off those six
students...

dialogues.jp: 果たして、これは偶然なのだろうか。
dialogues.en: That can't have just been a coincidence?
dialogues.text: That can't have just been a coincidence?

dialogues.jp:
興奮状態の環は、しばらく俺の腕を握って、離
さなかった。
dialogues.en: She eventually calmed down, and released her grip on my arm.
dialogues.text: She eventually calmed down, and released her grip on my arm.

dialogues.jp: ◆環の力◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki's Power?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki's Power?◆

dialogues.jp: 図書館に行く途中、杉並に出会う。
dialogues.en: On the way to the library, I met Suginami.
dialogues.text: On the way to the library, I met Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は環のことを、『未来が読めるのではない
か』と勘ぐる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami hypothesized that Tamaki had the power to see the
future.
dialogues.text:
Suginami hypothesized that Tamaki had the power to see the
future.

dialogues.jp:
まさかと思ったが、環は本棚が倒れてくること
を予測していた。
dialogues.en:
Ironically enough, Tamaki then managed to foretell a
bookshelf collapsing.
dialogues.text:
Ironically enough, Tamaki then managed to foretell a
bookshelf collapsing.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環に予知能力があることを疑うのだった。
dialogues.en:
I still don't know what to think of her supposed
clairvoyance.
dialogues.text:
I still don't know what to think of her supposed
clairvoyance.
